name: deusa-analytics-monorepo
description: Plataforma interna de inteligência comercial B2B - Deusa Analytics

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.build: concurrently "cd backend && npm run build" "cd frontend && npm run build" && npm --prefix frontend run check:artifact
scripts.typecheck: concurrently "cd backend && npm run typecheck" "cd frontend && npm run typecheck"
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd backend && npm run lint" "cd frontend && npm run lint"
scripts.deadcode: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run deadcode" "npm --prefix frontend run deadcode"
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev
